defenders.name: Goblin
defenders.description: Quick stabs for very little gold.

defenders.name: Guard
defenders.description: Short reach, but every swing lands.

defenders.name: Archer
defenders.description: Picks off the strongest target. Arrows are never dodged.

defenders.name: Hunter
defenders.description: Hurls weighted nets that can pin an enemy for a moment.

defenders.name: Dark Wizard
defenders.description: Blasts groups. Magic ignores armour.

defenders.name: Druid
defenders.description: Casts Bind. Weak damage, but every hit holds its target still.

pathA.name: Entangle
pathA.description: Binds last longer and catch nearby enemies

defenders.name: Dwarf
defenders.description: Slow, heavy rocks crack armour for 4 seconds.

defenders.name: Ent
defenders.description: A walking tree. Lashing roots can pin enemies in place.

defenders.name: Skeleton Mage
defenders.description: Cursed enemies take more damage from everyone.

defenders.name: Moss Giant
defenders.description: Slams shake everything nearby and slow it down.

defenders.name: Kraken Tentacle
defenders.description: Bursts from the ground and holds whatever it grabs.

pathA.name: Crushing coils
pathA.description: Grabs hit nearby enemies, binds last longer

defenders.name: Lesser Demon
defenders.description: Fireballs that keep burning long after they land.

defenders.name: Saradomin Wizard
defenders.description: Divine bolts never miss. One path blesses nearby allies.

defenders.name: Elven Archer
defenders.description: Crystal arrows, with a chance of triple damage.

defenders.name: Knight of Ardougne
defenders.description: Plate-breaking sword work. One path rallies the line.

defenders.name: Ice Warrior
defenders.description: Freezing magic that slows whole groups.

defenders.name: Karil the Tainted
defenders.description: Tainted bolts from long range that lock up an enemy's legs. Never dodged.

pathA.name: Crippling bolts
pathA.description: Hit enemies also limp, slowed by 30%

defenders.name: Fire Giant
defenders.description: Each swing bursts into flame around the target.

defenders.name: Black Dragon
defenders.description: Rolling gouts of flame that scorch a wide area.

defenders.name: Jad
defenders.description: Huge, slow blasts that swap between physical and magic.

defenders.name: Vorkath
defenders.description: Undead fire that burns armour off and keeps on burning.

pathA.name: Rancid breath
pathA.description: Foes burn for longer, take +15% more

defenders.name: Kamil
defenders.description: Casts Ice Burst, freezing groups solid where they stand.

defenders.name: Abyssal Demon
defenders.description: Blinks to its target and strikes at once. Nothing dodges it.

defenders.name: Gargoyle
defenders.description: Shatters armour and can pin the enemies around its target.

defenders.name: Sol Heredit
defenders.description: A blindingly quick spear. One path inspires everyone close by.

defenders.name: Ancient Wyvern
defenders.description: Bitter cold that slows everything and sometimes freezes it.

defenders.name: Zuk
defenders.description: A long wind-up, then a blast that crosses half the field.

maps.name: Lumbridge Fields
description: A long road through peaceful fields.
Hold out for wave 25, then see how
far you can go. 99 waves in all.

maps.name: Varrock Outskirts
description: Two lanes meet at the city gate.
Enemies march 20% faster.

maps.name: Morytania Marshes
description: Haunted mist slows your defenders
by 10%, and everything here shrugs
off 20% more magic.

maps.name: TzHaar Caverns
description: The horde splits around a molten
island, then rejoins at the gate.
+50% enemy health, kills pay extra.

maps.name: Chambers of Xeric
description: Ancient corridors with a route that
shifts every 5 waves. Only the lit
path is open, so cover them all.

maps.name: Wilderness Crossing
description: Two roads cross with barely anywhere
to build. You fight skulled: half keep
health, but 50% more gold.

maps.name: Theatre of Blood
description: A long spiral to a keep at the heart
of the theatre. Nylocas burst when
killed, and each death heals others.
